$comment: MCP tool servers available to the visualization agent.
Same shape as Claude Desktop / Cursor, so entries can be pasted between them.
This file is committed: keep secrets in .env and reference them as ${VAR}
inside env, args, url or headers.
transport is inferred from the entry shape ('command' -> stdio, 'url' -> http)
and may also be set explicitly. Set enabled to false to keep an entry without
starting it. Override the file location with MCP_CONFIG_PATH.
assetHosts is an SSRF boundary: only these hosts may serve images the server returns.
